name: Jessy Felix
summary: Jessy Felix is the brand/social media manager for Pomelo Bio (peptide supplement company, IG handle @pepstryde), working alongside their CEO David. She hired ALTR Services to recover the company's repeatedly suspended Instagram account and is also asking for help regaining access to their Facebook/Meta Business and TikTok accounts, which a former employee locked them out of (changed passwords, kept the Facebook authenticator on her phone). As of 2026-08-27 the IG account was still suspended/blank, Derrek agreed the 2-week warranty would not start until the account is actually restored, and the team was told to stop using @pomelobio.com email domains and move to a new domain. Follow-up: she needs 15-minute advance notice before any login code request so she can coordinate with David, who holds the Google Authenticator.
